hypotheses.text: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) introduces an implicit bias towards flat minima in deep learning models due to its reliance on noisy gradient estimates, which can lead to convergence in regions of the loss landscape that are less sensitive to perturbations. This bias may enhance model generalization by favoring solutions that are robust to input variations. Therefore, the stochasticity inherent in SGD is hypothesized to be a key factor in shaping the landscape of minima encountered during training.
